oneRecord.title: One sale. Everywhere it matters, at once.
oneRecord.intro: A sale at the till is not four jobs in four systems. It is one record that everything reads.

steps.title: The price is agreed
steps.body: Ada sends quotation QUO-0221 as a link. Tunde answers with his own price, and she accepts it inside her limit.

steps.title: The papers write themselves
steps.body: The agreed quote becomes the invoice and the sales order in one tap. Nobody types the lines again.

steps.title: Stock and delivery follow
steps.body: Forty cartons leave the Main store on waybill WB-0097, and Tunde signs for them at the door.

steps.title: Paid, and the books agree
steps.body: Tunde pays from the invoice link. The receipt goes out and the sale and VAT post to the books by themselves.

story.link: Follow one sale, start to finish
story.poster: Ada and Tunde agree a price on quotation QUO-0221. The quote is stamped agreed.

items.text: Two-step sign-in, and single sign-on with SAML or OIDC.
See every device that is signed in, and sign any of them out.
Passwords and keys for your connections are sealed and never shown again.
A finance audit trail that cannot be quietly changed, and no approving your own payments.
Our support team reaches your account only when you allow it, read-only and recorded.
Certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II.
